Messages.Author: Tadeusz
Messages.Body:
Hi all!

It's been ages since I last checked this newsgroup. I read about the
return to WW last week, and I was wondering what the reactions in here
were like.
What changes have there been for the game in the last year or so? I've
heard some talk of a mini-expansion, of promo cards. I believe none of
it reached France. Am I wrong? Is the newsgroup as active? Do we still
have CL wars once a trimester?
Somebody mentioned AH and Sabbat being hard to find and/or expensive.
Can someone give me an idea of the price of a complete AH or Sabbat
collection?
One last thing: in the current state of the rules, is it mandatory for
a minion to strike when in combat (or can you "spare" Smudge from time
to time?)?

See ya all. It's nice to hear that Jyhad still undead and kicking.

Tad

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Tadeusz wrote:
> One last thing: in the current state of the rules, is it mandatory for
> a minion to strike when in combat (or can you "spare" Smudge from time
> to time?)?

You must strike (if you have a strike).
Even at long range, (if you select no other strike) you're strike will be
(an ineffective) "hand strike".
